# Pose Landmarker Lite

Bundled model: `pose_landmarker_lite.task`, float16, version 1.

Downloaded from Google's published model distribution:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task

Task documentation and model card links:
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker

Runs alongside Hand Landmarker in `hand-tracking-worker.js` with the existing
vendored MediaPipe Tasks Vision runtime. All models and inference stay local.
